name: Quick quiz
description: Fast general-knowledge quizzes with three choices per question, a pause to think and a clear reveal.

definition.brief: Each video asks a handful of general-knowledge questions about one subject, offers three choices for each, pauses so viewers can guess, then reveals the answer with one interesting fact. Questions are fair, unambiguous and accurate, and the wrong choices are believable.
definition.music_mood: bouncy, upbeat game-show style music with light percussion and plucked synths

intro_line.en: Welcome to {series}. Get ready to guess!

outro_line.en: Thanks for playing. How many did you get right?
